evidence_or_owed: Section 7 cancels the active parts and explains why the shift with an infinite ordinary heat trace does not admit this trace calculation.

clause: Two block forms and their oriented decompositions
evidence_or_owed: The moving splitting gives both block forms. TAUM defines its oriented maps as −d and d*, so its difference and sum are exactly the displayed d + d* and d* − d.

clause: Grassmannian tangent and its Krein branch
draft_quote: It is the tangent vector to the family of subspaces.

clause: Projected connection on the range bundle
evidence_or_owed: Defined for sections of the moving subspaces, with its compatibility with the inner product.

clause: Commutator, compression and curvature as a mixed return
evidence_or_owed: Proved for vector fields of class C1, including the bracket term, and specialized to commuting coordinate fields as in TAUM.

clause: Ordered mixed product of two tangent channels

evidence_or_owed: Defined as the product of the adjoint of one tangent map with the other, on the selected subspace. In the notation of Section 7 it is d_Y* d_Z, which equals TAUM's signed product of the oriented pair.

clause: Antisymmetrization of oriented excursions
evidence_or_owed: The curvature is displayed as the difference of the two mixed returns, with their order, in the differential notation of Section 7.

clause: Positivity of a single return

The worked example shows two tangent maps into the same complex line whose imaginary ratio makes the mixed return anti-Hermitian.

clause: Frame connection, adjoint sign and curvature matrix
evidence_or_owed: Frames, the connection matrix and its curvature are defined. Part (a) of the proposition gives the anti-Hermitian sign. Local existence of frames is shown by a formula.

clause: Second Chern character and interpretation of characteristic numbers

evidence_or_owed: Part (b) compresses the Schur formula of Section 8 by a port that maps into the retained space.

clause: Operator Cayley transform of the passive response
evidence_or_owed: Defined on the upper half-plane.

evidence_or_owed: First statement of the proposition, with the lower bounds for the operator and its adjoint, closed dense range, and an inverse of norm at most one for port spaces of any dimension.

clause: Analyticity, defect identity and contractivity
evidence_or_owed: The congruence with four times the imaginary part is derived and the norm bound follows.

clause: Operator-valued de Branges–Rovnyak kernel
evidence_or_owed: Defined with the denominator and sign convention of TAUM.

clause: Finite-line resolvent and Fourier sums

clause: Time-domain positive definiteness
